calls.title: 30 min with Karen (Jake Heier)
calls.summary: Jake Heier (sales) and Karen Henke (product/marketing) discussed GrowthBook’s advantages over competitor Statsig, including transparent open-source SQL, flexible AI integration, white-glove support, and scalable pricing—though per-seat costs can be a drawback for broad access. Key pain points included Statsig’s reduced support, pricing volatility, and lack of AI story. Next steps: Karen will draft an improved security page, revamp industry pages, and explore a blog on GrowthBook’s architecture for handling billions of events.
